result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [emit_otel()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: >- Create a final action that sends a validation's metrics to OpenTelemetry. twitter-card: title: >- [emit_otel()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: >- Create a final action that sends a validation's metrics to OpenTelemetry. title: >- [emit_otel()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: >- Create a final action that sends a validation's metrics to OpenTelemetry. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Create a final action that sends a validation's metrics to OpenTelemetry. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/integrations/otel.py#L698-L875){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature emit_otel( *, meter_name="pointblank", enable_metrics=True, enable_tracing=False, enable_logging=False, meter_provider=None, tracer_provider=None, logger_provider=None, metric_prefix="pb.validation", log_level="warning", extra_attributes=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The `emit_otel()` function returns an action for [`FinalActions`](`pointblank.FinalActions`) that sends validation metrics to OpenTelemetry (OTel) at the end of every [`interrogate()`](`pointblank.Validate.interrogate`) call. With the action in the validation plan, every run reports to the monitoring backend without any code after the validation. That suits validations that run on a schedule, such as checks in a data pipeline. The action sends the metrics of [`OTelExporter`](`pointblank.integrations.otel.OTelExporter`), with these differences: - It sends metrics only. The `enable_tracing=`, `enable_logging=`, `tracer_provider=`, `logger_provider=` and `log_level=` arguments currently have no effect. Use [`OTelExporter.export()`](`pointblank.integrations.otel.OTelExporter.export`) after the interrogation for traces and log records. - It doesn't send the step duration histogram (`{prefix}.step.duration`), so there are 11 metrics instead of 12. - The only attributes are `pb.tbl_name` (when the validation has a `tbl_name=`) and those in `extra_attributes=`. Without `meter_provider=`, the metrics go to OTel's global meter provider, which discards them until the application sets up the OTel SDK. The OTel packages are an optional dependency, installed with `pip install pointblank[otel]`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [meter_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["pointblank"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The name that identifies Pointblank as the source of the metrics (the OTel instrumentation scope). The default is `"pointblank"`. [enable_metrics]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to send the metrics. The default is `True`. [enable_tracing]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Currently has no effect. The default is `False`. [enable_logging]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Currently has no effect. The default is `False`. [meter_provider]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : An OTel `MeterProvider` for the metrics. The default is `None`, which uses the global meter provider. [tracer_provider]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Currently has no effect. The default is `None`. [logger_provider]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Currently has no effect. The default is `None`. [metric_prefix]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["pb.validation"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The prefix for the names of the metrics. The default is `"pb.validation"`. [log_level]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["warning"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Currently has no effect. The default is `"warning"`. [extra_attributes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A dictionary of attributes to add to every metric, such as the environment or the name of the pipeline. The default is `None`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Callable]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A function to use in `FinalActions`. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ImportError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the OTel packages aren't installed. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Let's add the action to a validation of a small table of orders. The OTel SDK's `InMemoryMetricReader` keeps the metrics in memory so we can look at them (in production, the meter provider would send them to a collector instead): ::: {#893b6648 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb import polars as pl from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics.export import InMemoryMetricReader reader = InMemoryMetricReader() meter_provider = MeterProvider(metric_readers=[reader]) orders = pl.DataFrame( { "amount": [29.99, 150.00, -5.00, 75.50, 0.00], "customer": ["Alice", "Bob", None, "Dana", "Eve"], } ) validation = ( pb.Validate( data=orders, tbl_name="orders", thresholds=(0.05, 0.20, 0.40), final_actions=pb.FinalActions( pb.emit_otel(meter_provider=meter_provider, extra_attributes={"env": "dev"}) ), ) .col_vals_not_null(columns="customer") .col_vals_gt(columns="amount", value=0) .interrogate() ) metrics = reader.get_metrics_data().resource_metrics[0].scope_metrics[0].metrics for metric in metrics: print(metric.name, metric.data.data_points[0].value) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` pb.validation.steps.total 2 pb.validation.steps.passed 0 pb.validation.steps.failed 2 pb.validation.test_units.total 10 pb.validation.test_units.passed 7 pb.validation.test_units.failed 3 pb.validation.pass_rate 0.7 pb.validation.duration 0.005109 pb.validation.threshold.warning 2 pb.validation.threshold.error 2 pb.validation.threshold.critical 1 ``` ::: ::: The metrics were sent during `interrogate()`. Both steps failed, 7 of the 10 test units passed, and the second step exceeded all three thresholds. Each metric has the `pb.tbl_name` and `env` attributes: ::: {#424bb3ea .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} dict(metrics[0].data.data_points[0].attributes) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {'pb.tbl_name': 'orders', 'env': 'dev'} ``` ::: ::: Since `FinalActions` takes any number of actions, the metrics can be sent along with other notifications. Here, a [`send_slack_notification()`](`pointblank.send_slack_notification`) action without a webhook URL prints the message it would send: ::: {#dce0154c .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} validation = ( pb.Validate( data=orders, tbl_name="orders", thresholds=(0.05, 0.20, 0.40), final_actions=pb.FinalActions( pb.emit_otel(meter_provider=meter_provider), pb.send_slack_notification(), ), ) .col_vals_not_null(columns="customer") .col_vals_gt(columns="amount", value=0) .interrogate() ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` === Dry Run === Would send to Slack: *Data Validation Summary* • Highest Severity: critical • Total Steps: 2 • Failed Steps: 2 • Time: 2026-10-29 12:56:14.594144 ============== ``` ::: ::: The actions run in the order they're given, so the metrics are sent before the Slack message. The message summarizes the same results as the metrics: both steps failed, and the highest threshold level reached was critical. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~integrations.otel.OTelExporter`) : Send metrics, traces and log records after an interrogation. [](`~FinalActions`) : Run actions after an interrogation. [](`~send_slack_notification`) : Send a Slack notification from a final action.
